faq.description: Answers to common questions about the 2.0 Ingenium diesel in the Land Rover Discovery 5. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: Can an Evoque or Discovery Sport Ingenium engine fit my Discovery 5?
faqs.a: Not directly. Those models use transverse installations, while the Discovery 5 engine is mounted longitudinally with different ancillaries. We check your VIN and engine code before recommending a compatible replacement.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt Ingenium engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

faqs.q: Can I buy a Discovery 5 Ingenium engine supply only?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the cost of a Discovery 5 204DTA engine replacement?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any parts needed such as a DPF or turbo, and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a written quote.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on a replacement 204DTA engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver 2.0 Ingenium engines across the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

faqs.q: How long does a Discovery 5 engine replacement usually take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your 204DTA?
workshopIntro.description: The fault, mileage and value of your Discovery 5 decide the best approach. DPF, EGR, AdBlue and turbo faults can often be repaired individually. If chain failure has caused valve damage or oil dilution has worn the bearings, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery 5 204DTA engine replacement is usually more practical.
paragraphs: Modern diesel engines depend on healthy emissions and oil systems. Where relevant, we inspect the DPF, EGR system, turbos, intercooler, AdBlue components and cooling system, and renew the oil, filters and coolant before the replacement engine runs.

Send your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain the options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery across the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common Discovery 5 Ingenium Problems
engineProblems.description: The 2.0 Ingenium diesel often shows warning signs early, so prompt checks can prevent costly internal damage.

cards.title: Rear Timing Chain Stretch
cards.description: A rattle on start-up, camshaft correlation codes or uneven running may indicate a stretched timing chain. On this engine the chain sits at the rear, so access is involved. We check chain stretch and camshaft timing.

cards.title: Rising Oil Level from Fuel Dilution
cards.description: An oil level that rises between services or an oil change warning may point to diesel entering the sump during repeated DPF regeneration attempts. We check oil condition and regeneration history.

cards.title: Particulate Filter Loading
cards.description: DPF warning lights, reduced power or frequent regenerations often follow short journeys or sensor faults that stop the particulate filter clearing properly. We read soot data and assess the DPF.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: EGR Cooler and Valve Faults
cards.description: Rough running, hesitation, coolant loss or EGR fault codes may be caused by a sticking EGR valve or a leaking EGR cooler. We test EGR operation and inspect the cooler.

cards.title: Twin-Turbo Boost Problems
cards.description: On Sd4 models, flat spots, limp mode or boost fault codes may relate to the two-stage turbo system, its control valves or leaking intake hoses. We test boost control and turbo condition.

cards.title: AdBlue and SCR Warnings
cards.description: On later models, AdBlue warnings, start countdown messages or emissions faults may come from a faulty SCR heater, pump, sensor or injector. We read fault codes and test the system.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery 5 204DTA Engine: Your Complete Ingenium Diesel Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery 5 204DTA engine is the 2.0-litre four-cylinder Ingenium diesel fitted to Sd4 and Td4 versions of the fifth-generation Discovery. Efficient for its size, it works hard in a large SUV, and timing chain stretch, oil dilution, DPF and EGR problems often lead owners to seek repair or replacement.

The Discovery 5 Ingenium engine is mounted longitudinally, unlike the transverse versions used in the Evoque and Discovery Sport, and outputs and turbo arrangements also vary. We identify the correct engine by checking your VIN, engine code and registration.

Whether you need a targeted repair, an engine rebuild or a complete Land Rover Discovery 5 204DTA engine replacement, our team assesses the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
